name: Macaron
insight: Rather than just chatting, it builds you a custom personal 'mini-app' for a task, generated in minutes.
tagline: A personal AI agent that builds you custom mini-apps and remembers your life.
description: Macaron is a consumer AI 'personal agent' that, instead of only answering in chat, generates small custom mini-apps to handle tasks like meal planning, fitness, schedules and reminders. A deep-memory system learns your preferences over time so it grows more personalized with use. It launched in August 2025 on iOS, Android and web, with English, Japanese and Korean support.
edge: Unlike chat-only companions, it spins up a bespoke mini-app per task and keeps a deep memory of your life to personalize them.
pros: Builds custom mini-apps, not just replies
cons: Consumer life focus, not work tasks
Limited to a few languages and regions
